REHAB demands curbs on land-share housing schemes
items.description: The Real Estate and Housing Association of Bangladesh (REHAB) has demanded an end to the unregulated housing business model in which land shares are sold with promises of delivering specific flats.

items.title: Foreign investors pull Tk 175cr from DSE in Oct
items.description: Foreign investors sold shares worth Tk 175 crore more than they bought on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) in October, as selling pressure intensified sharply in the latter half of the month.

items.title: BB eases LC cash margin for Ramadan essentials
items.description: The Bangladesh Bank (BB) has directed commercial banks to keep the cash margin for opening import letters of credit (LCs) for a set of essential food items at the minimum level ahead of Ramadan.

items.title: Bank Asia, Asia Insurance sign deal on motorcycle loans
items.description: Bank Asia PLC has signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) with Asia Insurance PLC to provide insurance coverage to customers taking out two-wheeler loans, making motorcycle purchases more convenient for prospective buyers.

items.title: Prime Bank launches entrepreneur training in Sylhet
items.description: Prime Bank PLC has launched a month-long, 100-hour training programme to develop the entrepreneurial skills of small and medium enterprise (SME) entrepreneurs in Sylhet.

items.title: Padma Oil posts 7.75% profit growth in Q1
items.description: Padma Oil Company Ltd reported a 7.75 percent year-on-year increase in earnings to Tk 169 crore in the July-September quarter of the 2026-27 financial year.

items.title: DBBL holds strategic conclave in Khulna
items.description: Dutch-Bangla Bank held a strategic conclave for its Khulna region at a local hotel in Khulna on November 6, in a hybrid format to formulate business strategies for its branches and strengthen customer service.

items.title: Citizens Bank opens sub-branch in Munshiganj
items.description: Citizens Bank PLC recently inaugurated its Ichapura sub-branch in Sirajdikhan, Munshiganj.
